messages:
incbot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: elevated 5xx rate from ingress-proxy in prod (service: gw-router). Severity: P1. Notifying oncall.

incbot: Incident channel created: #inc-2319876543. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/ingress-5xx. Use `--incident` flag to annotate.

sylvia: I’m oncall. seeing spikes in response 502/504 at the gateway. cpu on router pods normal, but we have a surge of upstream timeout errors. corr prefix sample: corr=0a1b2c3d.

omar: adding runtime /ingress. Any customer-facing alerts?

maria-cs: one customer reported degraded chat generation latencies and backend errors, ticket opened (CS-4512). They see a 502 when calling /v1/generate.

ben: attaching short timeline from logs alpha: 10:12:03 5xx rate begins, 10:12:17 spike to 45% 5xx, 10:14:00 mitigation routing change attempted.

kevin-sre: logs pulled for corr=0a1b2c3d: upstream returned ECONNRESET and context deadline exceeded from runtime pool. snippet:
```
[10:12:18] gw-router: request id=abc123 corr=0a1b2c3d upstream=runtime-12 status=502 detail="read tcp 10.0.4.5:443: i/o timeout"
[10:12:19] gw-router: request id=abc124 corr=0a1b2c3e upstream=runtime-14 status=504 detail="context deadline exceeded"
```

tara: runtime team, can you confirm if any recent deploys or scale events?

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: runtime/v2.9.1 to prod at 10:11:50 by @ci. Rollout: 12/12 pods.

omar: ok deploy landed ~20s before spike. could be config or a bad kernel on the runtime images. but kernel-level issues unlikely across all pods.

sylvia: initial hypothesis H1: runtime v2.9.1 has a regression causing slow accept/handshake -> gateway timeouts. H2: upstream connection pool exhaustion due to changes in keepalive/idle timeouts. H3: transient network flapping in AZ-a.

kevin-sre: collecting pod-level metrics now. ps: connection pool queue length jumped at 10:12:10. linking graphs: https://grafana.internal/d/xyz/ingress-pools?from=1670000000&to=1670000500

ben: can someone `kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=runtime -o wide` and share restarts? I see 0 restarts in the list in the console.

omar: running `kubectl logs runtime-12 -n prod --since=5m | grep -i timeout` gives repeated TLS handshake timeouts around 10:12:15. possible upstream library change.

kevin-sre: rolling a quick mitigation: increasing upstream pool size and enabling fallback to runtime-hot to offload. Applying policy now.

sylvia: please coordinate with product if customer impact will persist. Maria, ask CS to postpone any SLA comms until we have a mitigation outcome.

maria-cs: will hold. sending note to affected customers: "We're investigating elevated 5xx errors impacting generation. We'll update in 30m or sooner."

ben: mitigation applied at 10:16:12 — pool increased + fallback route enabled. 5xx % dropped from 45% to 7% by 10:18.

kevin-sre: confirming: post-mit graphs show decreased queue length and lower tail latencies. still seeing occasional isolated 504s.

omar: runtime team is starting a canary rollback to v2.8.7 in a small subset to validate. running helm action now.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout: runtime/v2.8.7 -> runtime-canary-1 at 10:21:03.

sylvia: great. let's build timeline and evidence for RCA. I’ll start the timeline doc in the channel.

ben: sharing compressed log bundle for 10:10-10:20: https://internal/logs/ingress/2319876543.tar.gz (contains request ids, headers, tcp traces). Password: redwood!

kevin-sre: extracted tcpdump for node-az-a shows increased retransmits at 10:12:09-10:12:20. might be noisy links in that AZ.

omar: runtime team: stacktrace from runtime-12 at 10:12:16 shows blocking in TLS renegotiation path. snippet:
```
goroutine 1128 [semacquire]:
  crypto/tls.(*Conn).Handshake(0xc0002f8000)
  /usr/local/go/src/crypto/tls/conn.go:1357 +0x1a4
```

tara: that ties to H1/H2. I'm leaning H2 + H1: change in TLS idle/keepalive made handshake more frequent and exposed a bug.

sylvia: next steps: 1) Confirm canary rollback results (15m). 2) Gather full correlation ids and map to customer requests (CS-4512). 3) Postmortem doc + blame-free root cause analysis.

maria-cs: mapping corr ids to customer sessions now. will post counts and examples.

kevin-sre: request all oncall to save local traces and attach to timeline doc. use cmd:
```
infra-tool export-trace --corr 0a1b2c3d --out /tmp/trace-0a1b2c3d.pcap
```

ben: noticed a pattern: failures concentrated at gateway pod gw-7 in AZ-a then fanout to other gw pods. might be upstream affinity / stickiness causing hotspot.

omar: can we toggle proxy-level routing to spread across more runtime replicas? if so, do it as temporary mitigation.

kevin-sre: toggled routing to round-robin at 10:26:05. small drop in error tail.

sylvia: handoff plan: @omar take primary for next 30m, @kevin-sre provide infra support, @tara runtime for canary rollback monitoring, @maria-cs to coordinate customer comms. I'll be onstandby and will prepare incident timeline.

omar: acknowledged. collecting final evidence for RCA. will open followup ticket to root cause: INC-2319876543-RCA.

maria-cs: update: CS-4512 customer reports errors cleared at 10:20 after mitigation. they confirm some requests failed but most recovered.

sylvia: excellent. we’ll reconvene in 1h for a quick sync and then create the full postmortem. please drop anything relevant into the thread (logs, commands, short notes).

kevin-sre: adding quick hypotheses list to thread for RCA tracking:
- H1: TLS handshake regression in runtime v2.9.1 increases blocking -> gateway timeouts.
- H2: Connection pool config combined with deploy caused sudden increase in handshakes and pool saturation.
- H3: AZ network blips amplified an already-tight resource.

omar: also adding mitigation/actions recorded:
- increased upstream pool size at 10:16
- enabled fallback routing to runtime-hot at 10:16:12
- canary rollback started at 10:21
- routing change to round-robin at 10:26

ben: saving thread logs and linking to incident binder: https://incidents.internal/2319876543. include any followup owners there.

sylvia: thanks all. please react with :white_check_mark: when you've uploaded evidence or assigned followups.

incbot: Incident update: severity degraded to P2 at 10:30 after mitigations. Will continue monitoring.

maria-cs: uploaded mapping of corr ids to customers: https://internal/cs/maps/2319876543.csv

omar: can we mark this as monitoring and capture if rollback fully resolves? if rollback proves clean, plan a stable rollout with patch to TLS path.

kevin-sre: logging captured forensics saved under /artifacts/inc-2319876543/ (owner: kevin-sre).

sylvia: end-of-thread for live mitigation. continuing RCA in doc. thanks everyone for fast responses.
